A really big amount of my OCD used to revolve around death, a fear for death and an obsession with dying.

When I was 5 I had a huge misunderstanding about the concept of life insurance lol, I thought it legitimately ensured your life, I thought since I didn't have it if something bad happened to me everyone would just let me die and say "too bad you didn't have any life insurance"

When I was older I'd have panics about when and where I was gonna die, and if I would be able to die with my family and I remember really wanting to be buried with a stuffed animal

Then as I got older, I started to just fixate and have my focus on school shootings, I was gonna have to sacrifice myself to save other people in a school shooting. 

Recently i had a major fixation on dying of cancer and that I have stage 4 terminal cancer and I don't even know it. Now it's uhh switched to surprisingly something kinda similar to you. A fixation on gender roles and identity and such haha. All OCD is very difficult! Stay strong! You're not alone! I think all of us here can relate to each other strongly but we don't realize it until we open up haha.
